segments.text: THe viſible Church of Chriſt is a Congregation of Faithful men, in the which the pure Word of God is preached, and the Sacraments be duly Miniſtred, according to Chriſt's Ordinance in all thoſe things that of neceſſity are requiſite to the ſame.
As the Church of Hieruſalem, Alexandria, and Antioch have erred; So alſo the Church of Rome hath erred, not only in their living and manner of Ceremonies, but alſo in matters of Faith.
